authorization: User requested approximate extrapolation from Weber data for simple configurations, without more input fields.
status: Experimental planning model; not empirically calibrated

solid.anchor: Approximately 2 kg briquettes for 57 cm kettle; heat up to 3 hours. Dividing these figures into a rate is a Lumbre modeling assumption, not a published consumption test.

gas.anchor: Spirit 2–3 burner published nominal figures: 0.494–0.623 kg/h LP, 7–8.7 kW.

pellets.anchor: Published approximate bands 0.5–1 kg/h at 95–150 C and 1.5–2 kg/h at 230–315 C.

lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.size_multiplier: kettle (diameter/57)^2; other equipment assumes domestic scale comparable to 57 cm
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.minimum_provision_kg: charcoal 0.98, briquettes 2, wood 3, multiplied by size and equipment factor capped at 1.5; a shopping floor, not an ignition load
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.natural_gas: 7–8.7 kW divided by assumed 10 kWh/m³, then duty factors; no LP mass-to-NG-volume conversion
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.pellets_intermediate: linear interpolation of band endpoints from 150 to 230 C
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.pellets_outside_bands: trend extension clamped to interpolation fractions -0.25–1.75; low floor .25 kg/h, high floor .75 kg/h
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.stages: envelope across active stage temperatures for total general hours; blank stage temperatures use method suggestions only within estimate; no parsing free-text duration
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.reserve: 25% of max(high consumption, shopping floor); round consumption/provision/reserve upward to 0.1
lumbre_assumptions_not_weber_claims.conditions: Dry fuel, domestic equipment, little wind, normal openings. Especially uncertain for wood and offset. Not for commercial equipment. Aromatic wood is not included or deducted from primary fuel.
